user.title: Later
user.description: Schedule one-off actions that run once and delete themselves.

not_loaded.message: Later is not set up. Add it under Settings > Devices & services.

action_needs_entity.message: A shortcut action (turn on, turn off, toggle) needs an entity.

add.name: Add
add.description: Runs an action once at a time, then deletes the schedule. Send either `at` or `in`, and either `action` or `service`.

action.name: Action
action.description: Shortcut for the entity's domain: turn_on, turn_off or toggle.

service.name: Service
service.description: Any service to call, as domain.service.

at.name: At
at.description: Clock time (20:00: today, or tomorrow once it has passed) or a date and time, in the Home Assistant time zone.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shown in the card and the logbook. Derived from the entity, action and time when left out.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Deletes a pending schedule without running it.

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Runs a pending schedule now, then deletes it.
